scope: Exactly one fixed algorithm, no best-of selection; arithmetic mean of per-case fixed official A baseline / P2 makespan. Only a complete 100-case core gets a full mean. Shared-resource wall times are observations, not exclusive-machine comparisons.

batches.coordination: 全500矩阵所有批已停止并审计后，才注册新变体和固定新source。本轮最多两P2 Sol lane各1worker，1核/4核容量两批与4核/1核/5核gap三批各自按固定顺序；每批前free≥1GB，否则批边界等待。与其他授权本机会话共享资源，墙钟注明共享，不作独占效率比较；活动账本/输出不读取，进度只stdout。每批900秒、solver30/E090、0retry首意外失败停。
